So simple and easy with great macros🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (4 Servings Total) 595 Calories | 59g Protein | 50g Carbs | 16g Fat Ingredients (To Make 4 Servings) Grilled Chicken - 800g Cubed Chicken Breast (I get mine from @saffron_alley ) - 1 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Parsley - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (remove if you don’t like spicy) - 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1.5 Tsp Paprika - 2 Tsp Olive Oil - 20g Light Buttet (For cooking + once cooked) Creamy Alfredo Pasta - 210g Uncooked / 520g Cooked Pasta (I chose fettuccine) - 80g Chopped White Onion - 4 Garlic Cloves Chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Parsley - 0.5 Tsp Chilli Flakes (remove if you don’t like spicy) - 1 Tsp Paprika - 150g Tomato Sauce / Passata  - 300ml Light Evaporated Milk (Brand: Sainsbury’s) - 130g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) - 30g Grated Parmesan Cheese - Optional add Pasta Water if the sauce is too thick Don’t forget to check out my Digital Cookbooks with over 200+ Delicious High Protein Recipes👨‍🍳❤️ Important Cooking Notes - Cook the chicken cubes on medium high heat, 3-4 mins then turn them over and cook for another 3 mins - Once cooked, lower the heat, add a little more butter then mix it all in and set aside - Cook the onion for 5-6mins till soft then add the spices. ⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 meal prep: Protein: 40g Carbs: 87g Fat: 8g Calories: 585 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 1lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 1/4 cup cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil - 1 tsp sesame seeds -1 green onion Soy Glaze Sauce - 2.5 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2.5 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic Cucumber Salad - 2 Persian cucumbers - 2 tsp salt - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds 1.5 cup cooked rice How to make it yourself: 1. Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. When ready to eat, microwave the rice with a wet paper towel first to get it steamed, then add in your meat and microwave till warm, and finally add your salad to preserve the crunch and enjoy! 📩 Save this Soy Glazed Chicken recipe to make for later! #highprotein #lowcaloriemeals #mealprep #mealplan #healthyrecipe #weightlossmeals #asianfood #chicken

videos.caption: Easy High Protein Meal Prep Honey BBQ Chicken Mac & Cheese🍗🧀 Most Viral Recipe of 2025! 🔥 100+ million views combined across all social media platforms, this high protein honey bbq chicken mac & cheese recipe is the tastiest & easiest meal prep recipe to start your health journey in 2026 👨🏻‍🍳🫡 (Macros: Per Serving - Recipe Makes 4 Servings) 587 Calories 67.5gC | 9gF | 59gP Ingredients: 700g Diced Chicken Breast (raw weight) 1 Tsp Each of Salt, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika & Garlic Powder 1 Tsp Olive Oil 25g Honey 85g Reduced Sugar or Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Hughes Sugar Free BBQ Sauce) 320g Macaroni Pasta (uncooked weight) 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy) 80g Light Cream Cheese 1.5 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder 100g Grated Light Cheddar Cheese (Dairyworks Natural Cheddar Cheese) Instructions: 1. Start by seasoning your diced chicken breast with 1 tsp each of salt, onion powder, smoked paprika & garlic powder then add 1 tsp of olive oil & mix well. 2. Cook the chicken on medium/high heat for 4 min each side or until cooked through, once the chicken is cooked take it off the heat & add 25g of honey with 85g of bbq sauce. 3. Mix well to combine until the chicken is coated in the sauce. 4. Start cooking 320g of pasta (uncooked weight) in boiling water according to package directions. 5. While the pasta is cooking to a pan on medium heat add 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk, 80g light cream cheese, 1.5 tsp chicken stock powder, 100g light grated cheddar cheese & continue stirring until the sauce is fully combined & smooth/creamy. 6. Add the cooked & drained pasta to the Mac & cheese sauce then mix until the pasta is fully coated. 7. Divide the Honey BBQ Chicken and Mac & Cheese into 4 equal servings for meal prep PRO TIP: Add a splash of milk before reheating your meal prep so the mac and cheese turns out creamy every time & mix well. #macandcheese #macncheese #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

Using a stove with the pan on medium heat cook the chicken with a lid for approximately 8 - 10 minutes per side or until fully cooked through, once cooked shred the chicken apart using 2 forks. 3. In a blender cup add low fat cottage cheese, chipotle seasoning, light mayonnaise, garlic, lime juice, chipotle in adobo sauce, buffalo sauce, honey & blend for 2 minutes until smooth & creamy. 4. In a large bowl combined the blended chipotle sauce, shredded chicken, chives & grated cheese until well combined. 5. Place a warm tortilla down & to one half add a layer of cheese followed by 1/10th of the filling, another layer of cheese & fold. 6. Toast on a pan on each side until golden brown & crispy, repeat for the other 9 quesadillas.  #quesadilla #chicken #highprotein #healthyrecipes #mealprep

For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. CHICKEN PARM🍝🔥578 cals 63g protein 16g fat 47g  Cookbook in bio 🔗 Ingredients: this makes 6 meals 2.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breast 28 oz can crushed tomatoes 15 oz can tomato sauce 2 tbsp tomato paste 1 small yellow onion, finely diced 4–5 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper ½ tsp red pepper flakes (optional) 1 whole block ⅓ fat cream cheese 8 oz pasta rigatoni ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan 1 bag reduced fat shredded mozzarella Fresh parsley Directions: 1. Add chicken breast to your slow cooker and season with Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper and red pepper flakes. 2. Add the diced onion, minced garlic, crushed tomatoes, tomato sauce and tomato paste. Place the cream cheese on top. 3. Cover and cook on HIGH for about 3 hours or LOW for 5–6 hours, until the chicken reaches 165°F and easily pulls apart. 4. Cook 12 oz pasta separately 5. Shred the chicken & stir everything together until the cream cheese is completely incorporated and the sauce is creamy. 6. Add ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan and the bag of reduced fat shredded mozzarella. Stir until everything is melted, creamy and coated. 7. Add fresh parsley & enjoy! Simple and easy meal prep using rotisserie chicken from Costco. 🔗Find my seasoning and link to 22oz glass containers in bio. Ingredients: 2 Rotisserie Chickens (Breast Only) 24 Tortillas 4” 2 Cans of Green Enchilada Sauce 7oz Choice of Cheese Green Onions optional Instructions: 1. Shred 2.5-3lbs of rotisserie chicken into a large mixing bowl. 2. Add about half of your enchilada sauce and mix with the chicken. 3. Potion out about 2oz of the chicken per enchilada and portion 3 enchiladas into 22oz glass containers. 4. Top with enchilada sauce and cheese. 5. Store in fridge for up to 4 days. Reheat in microwave on high for 2 minutes and top with your favorite toppings.

Street Corn Chicken Bowls🍗🌽🍚 Absolutely phenomenal flavors for how easy it is to make. Another game changing meal prep recipe, all done in one sheet pan, minimal effort for maximum taste🤤🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 637 Calories | 57g Protein | 55g Carbs | 21g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Mexican Grilled Chicken - 1300g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 1.5 Tsp Chilli Powder - 6 Tsp (30g) Olive Oil Creamy Street Corn Salad - 600g Canned Sweet Corn, drained - 200g Red Onion, chopped - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Paprika - 150g Red Bell Pepper, chopped - 80-100g Jalapeño, chopped - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 70-100g Low Fat Feta Cheese - 2 Tbsp Fresh Coriander/Cilantro, finely chopped - 2-3 Tsp Tajin Seasoning Coriander Lime Rice - 250g Uncooked Basmati Rice - Big Handful Coriander, finely chopped - Squeeze of Lime Juice - Pinch of Salt to taste 👨‍🍳Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from boneless chicken thighs. Add to bowl with Mexican seasoning, lime juice and olive oil. Mix well to marinate. 2. Add washed uncooked rice to a pot of water, bring to a boil then simmer on low heat until fully cooked. Once cooked, let it cool, add chopped corianderwith lime juice and pinch of salt. Mix well then set aside. 3. Get a large lined sheet pan, spread marinated chicken evenly then oven bake for 23 mins at 200C/390F and broil for 5-6 mins until golden brown, charred and juicy.  4. Remove chicken from pan, add sweetcorn, red onion, garlic powder and paprika. Mix in all the chicken juices then flatten evenly. Oven roast for just 15 mins until crispy. 5. Add roasted corn to a large mixing bowl, with all listed ingredients then mix well until creamy and delicious. 6. Chop the chicken into cubes, serve with cilantro lime rice and street corn salad and ENJOY! . . . #streetcorn #chickenrecipe #mealprep #healthyrecipes #weightloss
